t: On the Case: A Killer in Disguise
d: Police race to track down the unlikely killer responsible for three terrifying murders.

t: On the Case: Left in the Dark
d: When a beautiful young graduate student is found stabbed to death, detectives must determine if the murder was a crime of passion or a brutal attack by a violent intruder.

t: On the Case: Path of Tears
d: A 14-year-old girl is killed while walking her dog on a popular community bike trail.

t: On the Case: Signed In Blood
d: In order to solve the vicious double murder of a beloved couple, police must uncover a cold blooded killer's carefully calculated plot.

t: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 1
d: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On The Case.

t: On the Case: Over The Edge
d: Police are called to the scene of what appears to be a tragic car wreck in the Blue Ridge Mountains... But as Investigators examine the crash site they realize Wendy Kratzert's death was no accident.

t: On the Case: A Fateful Decision
d: A Young mother is kidnapped out of her driveway after a birthday celebration... Did a string of good luck, lead to her disappearance.

t: On the Case: Murder at Bird Key
d: A successful business man is found brutally murdered in his palatial Southern Florida home. A mysterious backpack found at the crime scene is the key to the case.

t: On the Case: Deadly Warning
d: When a 15-year-old girl vanishes in the middle of the night, a friend's terrifying secret may be the key to solving the case.

t: On the Case: In Broad Daylight
d: A young mother is murdered in broad daylight with her toddler just a few feet away. Police have little to go on except the bizarre description eyewitnesses have given them of the brazen killer.

t: On the Case: A Mystery on Cherry Hill
d: When a beautiful young woman vanishes without a trace, it may take another tragedy before police will be able to solve the mystery of her disappearance.

t: On the Case: A Killer in Town
d: Paula Zahn examines how police raced to track down a vicious killer on his deadly cross-country journey.

t: On the Case: Greed, Lies and Murder
d: Fifty-year-old mother of three Marilou Johnson disappears from the home of her boyfriend, Roger Blanchard, a wealthy retired businessman, then it becomes clear Johnson has met with foul play.

t: On the Case: Vanished in the Night
d: When 20 year old Lynsie Ekelund suddenly goes missing in the dead of night, it leaves her mother scrambling for answers.

t: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
d: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

t: On the Case: Darkness in The Desert
d: Paula Zahn investigates the story of a Las Vegas starlet who mysteriously vanished during a visit to a local spy store.

t: On the Case: River of Tears
d: Paula examines the discovery of a young woman's lifeless body on the bank of a shallow river. A note in her pocket may point to her killer.

t: On the Case: Painful Memories
d: A young marine comes home and finds his nine month pregnant wife savagely beaten in their bedroom. Was he an innocent victim or could he have been responsible for the terrible crime.

t: On the Case: Last Dance
d: A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

t: On the Case: Screams for Justice
d: The eyewitness accounts of neighbors may help or hinder investigators as they seek to solve the murder of a young woman.
